reviews.t: Great product for an even better price
reviews.x: This pack of brushes worked magnificently on my Oral B toothbrush. Consequently, I will be purchasing all of my brush heads from Health +, including the sensitive packs if these run out. Overall, these brush heads are not only cheaper than Oral B, but also a better overall product. I have wasted hundreds, maybe even thousands of dollars, on Oral B brush-heads over the past five years.  Don't fall for the trap that big brands, such as Oral B, have benefited from as a result of their own brand rec

Came off the toothbrush too easily. I actually stabbed myself in the cheek because the head came off while I was brushing and didn’t notice. I won’t be buying this brand again, and am about to purchase some alternative heads because I’m worried about using these and the head coming off in my mouth again.  The package is a card-backed plastic seal, rather than a box like other brands, which makes it more difficult to store the spare heads before you use them. A box would be better, as then you ha

reviews.t: Definitely a cheaper alternative but not the same
reviews.x: These replacement head fit perfectly but the bristles are softer and not as durable as the original ones. They are of average quality.

I was worried buying a non-oral b branded replacement head but had used a cvs version on my oral b in the past that worked ok. These have worked really well and they actually fit and feel comfortable when brushing. Totally worth the price. I'm not sure we'll use all the different "versions" of the heads, but even using 8 of them still makes the price unbeatable.

Wow - what a deal! These heads worked perfectly with my Oral B toothbrush and there are multiple different types, with duplicates of each type, so you can ensure you get the right brush. I am over the moon to have received these so quickly and have been using my new heads every day. The seller was super communicative and helpful - overall really happy with the quality of this purchase, especially for the price!

reviews.t: Bought these as a cheaper alternative... You get what you pay for.
reviews.x: Bought these as a cheaper alternative to the Oral-B originals but after using them once I decided to throw them out. They are noticeably cheaper quality both the bristles and the mechanism in the brush head. First thing I noticed pulling them out of the pack is that the bristles are a mess. The Oral-B head, even after 3 months of use still looks less beaten up than this brand does put of the package (See attached pic). Additionally the mechanism is a lot less smooth and this brush head is notice
I likes everything about these!  It's a variety pack for your teeth.  Great price, well made & perfect for what I was looking for.  This generic is just as good as buying brand name!
We have 2 different models of Oral B toothbrushes and they fit both with no issues.  I like the variety.

reviews.t: Highly recommend and will purchase again
reviews.x: My husband and I both have an Oral-B toothbrush. But they are different Styles. This assortment pack can be used on both toothbrushes. Each different personal is designed to reach a certain area in the mouth our gums. A great value for your money. Shipped very quickly. Highly recommend and will purchase again
This bundle of toothbrushes has just about every type of help you might need for brushing.  Shipping was very fast.
Great for cleaning spot stains on teeth. Not great for bad breath. You still need to brush a toothbrush to brush the tongue N don’t forget to floss you filthy animals.

reviews.t: 2xs as many heads than necessary but fit fine
reviews.x: Fit my OralB electric toothbrush. Wish they made a pkg half the size. Really didn't need duplicates of every head.
These generic oral bs are THE BEST they work perfectly and are amazing! Pick some up today!
So far so good! We are enjoying our new brushes. They fit the appliance well.

reviews.t: Best bang for your buck on replacement heads!!!
reviews.x: Arrived quickly and product fits perfectly. But the value is the BEST!!
Just like oral b for a lot less money, no complaints here great price
These are just as good as the name brand. I'm satisfied with them.

reviews.t: Purchased for my 97 year old mom
reviews.x: Mom has never used an electric toothbrush..Oral B  was recommended by her dentist because flossing is difficult. She has arthritis. I purchased the replacements for her so she could try the options you provide--softer action, flossing. She is still tying to get used to the Oral B. Again her arthritis makes it difficult to hold the large base of the toothbrush. She's still working with it.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: Frankly I’m amazed about all of the super good reviews on this product. As the headline says, you get what you pay for.  They look very summer to the Oral B product.  Unfortunately they are not made tightly.  When I use one they pinch my lip because they are not tight up against the base.  The good news is they don’t cost a lot so when I threw them out it really didn’t bother me.

I knew I was getting a package of ten brush heads, but I didn't know they were of different kinds. This is a nice sample pack of brush heads with different purposes. Though I haven't had a chance to use any of them yet (still using my existing brush head), they look to be of good quality, and I will enjoy trying out the different kinds.

It is wonderful to be able to try the entire variety of brushes without having to buy an expensive quantity from the manufacturer which is not available in a variety pack.  I did have a bit of trouble figuring out which brush was for what based on the color coding.  I do wish that they were marked a bit better.

Purchasing these Healthline replacement heads for the Oral B was one of my smartest moves this year. They fit perfectly on the Oral B hand held device and work like a champ. The is a great product and is a cost effective option for purchase of replacement heads for my Oral B toothbrush.

These brush heads are perfect.  I got my husband a new oral b for Christmas, along with a pack of these brushes.  He loves them, switches from day to day, says his teeth feel cleaner and gums less tender than in years.  Congratulations on providing good service and a great product.

Works just like the original Oral B brushes, contains the full assortment of specialty brushes most of which can be used for general cleaning, only one is designed for dental braces which is small and detailed. Quite happy with product and great bargain for the money.

reviews.t: Found no difference as compared to regular Oral B brush heads
reviews.x: I especially liked the price and the fact that, as far as I can tell, these are just as effective as the genuine Oral B brushes.  I will certainly purchase them again and can honestly recommend them to anyone who doesn't want to spend what Oral B's usually cost.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise these as a great value and much cheaper than the brand-name alternative.
Many customers report the heads fit their Oral-B toothbrushes well and work as expected.
Several reviewers appreciate the variety pack with multiple head types and duplicates.
Some customers find the quality inferior, with softer, less durable bristles and a cheaper mechanism than the originals.
A few reviewers report the heads come off too easily, with one describing the head detaching mid-brush.
